top_signals.title: Credit Agricole Reports Higher Profit, Warns of France Risk
top_signals.summary: Clotilde L'Angevin, deputy general manager at Credit Agricole, speaks on Bloomberg Television after the lender joined its French rivals in reporting higher profit for the third quarter, but warned that the recent turmoil in France could hurt business there in coming months. "Going forward, we want to remain very cautious because it is possible that the macroeconomic environment will have an impact on loan demand," L'Angevin says. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 17 September 2026
top_signals.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.
